SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL FOLLOWS PROVISION OF UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AS ADDRESSED IN ASC 958. THE SCHOOL RECOGNIZES ACCRUED INTEREST AND PENALTIES ASSOCIATED WITH UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AS PART OF THE INCOME TAX PROVISION, WHEN APPLICABLE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule E, Line 3 - Racially Nondiscriminatory Policy Publicized
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL HAS AN OPEN ENROLLMENT POLICY THAT IS RACIALLY NONDISCRIMINATORY. ALL POLICIES ARE PROVIDED TO STUDENTS AND PARENTS IN WRITING DURING THE ENROLLMENT PROCESS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Schedule E, Line 4 - Explanation of Records and Materials Not Maintained
Schedule E, Line 5 - Explanation of Organization Discrimination by Race
Schedule E, Line 6 - Explanation of Aid or Assistance from Governmental Agency
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOLS RECEIVE GRANTS FROM THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT, GRANTS AND STATE AID FROM STATE GOVERNMENT, AND TRANSFERS OF PROPERTY TAXES FROM LOCAL SCHOOL DISTRICTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE FINANCE DIVISION, CHIEF BUSINESS OFFICER & CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER, AND A REPRESENTATIVE FROM THE BOARD.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL GOVERNING BOARD MEMBERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES ARE REQUIRED TO DISCLOSE THEIR FINANCIAL INFORMATION AND ANY POSSIBLE CONFLICTS OF INTEREST BY FILLING OUT FORM 700, WHICH IS THEN FILED IN THE COUNTY THAT THE ORGANIZATION CONDUCTS BUSINESS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15a
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: A COMPENSATION COMMITTEE DESIGNATED BY THE BOARD REVIEW AND APPROVES COMPENSATION FOR TOP MANAGEMENT AND KEY EMPLOYEES. SALARIES ARE BASED UPON AVAILABILITY OF BUDGET AND COMPARABLE WAGES FOR SIMILAR POSITIONS IN THE INDUSTRY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section C, Line 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AFTER APPROVAL FROM THE BOARD, FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE SUBMITTED PERIODICALLY TO THE ORGANIZATION'S AUTHORIZING AGENCY, COUNTY OFFICE OF EDUCATION AND THE STATE CONTROLLER'S OFFICE. IN ADDITION, ALTUS SCHOOLS SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA COMPLIES WITH THE PUBLIC RECORDS ACT MANDATING DISCLOSURE OF NON-EXEMPT GOVERNMENTAL RECORDS TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST. IT ALSO COMPLIES WITH THE BROWN ACT WHICH REQUIRES ALTUS SCHOOLS SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA PROVIDE PUBLIC NOTICE OF ALL REGULAR AND SPECIAL BOARD MEETINGS. ALL BOARD MEETINGS ARE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC.
